standard: FR Y-14M / CCAR-aligned loan-level edit checks

rules.name: LOAN_ID_PRESENT
rules.description: Every remittance record must carry a loan identifier.

rules.name: REPORTING_MONTH_PRESENT
rules.description: Every record must carry a reporting period.

rules.name: BALANCE_SIGN
rules.description: Unpaid principal balance may not be negative.

rules.name: BALANCE_CEILING
rules.description: Balance may not exceed the original balance absent a capitalising modification.

rules.name: DPD_RANGE
rules.description: Days past due must fall within a plausible reporting range.

rules.name: STATUS_DOMAIN
rules.description: Performance status must be a recognised state.

rules.name: SEQUENTIAL_DELINQUENCY
rules.description: Delinquency status and days past due must agree; buckets may not be skipped.

rules.name: ABSORBING_STATE_FINALITY
rules.description: A prepaid or defaulted loan is terminal and must carry a zero balance.

rules.name: DEFAULT_DELINQUENCY_CONSISTENCY
rules.description: A defaulted loan must be at least 90 days delinquent.

rules.name: TEMPORAL_ORDERING
rules.description: A performance record may not predate origination.

rules.name: RATE_RANGE
rules.description: Note rate must fall within a plausible range.

rules.name: TERM_NON_NEGATIVE
rules.description: Remaining term may not be negative.

rules.name: MUTUALLY_EXCLUSIVE_TERMINATION
rules.description: A loan cannot both default and prepay in the same period.

rules.name: DOCUMENT_STATUS_DOMAIN
rules.description: Document status must be a recognised value.
